d:
Celebrate the festive energy of Bappa from Banjo in stunning 8K/4K Ultra HD. Sung powerfully by Vishal Dadlani, with music by Vishal & Shekhar and lyrics by Amitabh Bhattacharya, this high-energy track brings together infectious beats, vibrant celebration and the spirit of Ganpati Bappa Morya.
Turn up the volume, feel the beats and celebrate the festive spirit with Bappa!
Song Credits
Song – Bappa
Film – Banjo
Singer – Vishal Dadlani
Music – Vishal & Shekhar
Lyrics – Amitabh Bhattacharya
